analysis_method: Prespecified subgroup risk ratio reported by the trial; uncertainty sampled from the published 95% CI

analysis_method: GEE Poisson regression accounting for household clustering

analysis_method: GEE Poisson regression within the Japan geographic subgroup (EMA assessment report Table 71)
notes: Exploratory regional subgroup, all risk levels; not powered for within-region inference.

analysis_method: High-risk subgroup risk ratio applied to the Japan-region baseline risk in an exploratory scenario
notes: Combines the Japan-region placebo risk with the prespecified high-risk subgroup effect; the Japan-by-high-risk cross-classification was not reported.

analysis_method: Overall-trial GEE risk ratio applied to the Japan-region baseline risk in an exploratory scenario
